base.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE production RGBA full-character attack sprite atlas for Tofufu Adventure.
Reference image: the supplied image is the exact character identity and outfit reference, NOT an image to reuse as the output. Render this character actually performing whole-body martial arts moves.
Subject: Base Fufu: the exact buttery cream bean body, tiny cream mitten hands, tiny bare bean feet, two-leaf sprout, dark forest-green outlines, soft yellow pores, rosy cheeks and simple cute eyes of the reference. No clothing or armour.
Style: exactly match reference cute chibi bean proportions, polished painted shading, crisp dark outlines. No realistic human anatomy. Retain short tiny limbs, large bean-shaped head/body and sprout.
Composition: portrait sprite sheet, 4 equal columns and 5 equal rows, exactly 20 complete characters. Prefer 2048x2560. Genuinely transparent background. Every cell has generous transparent gutters; no part reaches a cell boundary. Keep every character entirely inside its own cell, including raised mitts, boots, sprout and cape. All poses have the same head size and supporting foot baseline within their row.
COLUMNS are four DIFFERENT attack contact poses:
1 JAB: one short arm fully extended into a quick straight jab, opposite mitten tucked at cheek, bean body leaning slightly into the strike, feet apart.
2 CROSS: opposite arm extended, torso twisting, opposite shoulder comes forward and rear heel lifts, clearly different silhouette from jab.
3 UPPERCUT: a bent punching arm driving upwards, fist near or just above cheek level, body slightly crouched and twisting, opposite mitt guarding, legs braced.
4 KICK: one leg lifted and fully extended into an obvious waist-height front/side kick, sole or toe visible, body leaning back, BOTH mitts guarding face, only the supporting foot touches the ground. This must be a kick, NOT a fourth punching pose.
ROWS are five camera-relative viewing directions of those same four moves:
row1 FRONT (S): looks/attacks towards viewer, face visible, foreshortened strikes.
row2 FRONT-LEFT THREE-QUARTER (SW): face and left-facing profile, attacks diagonally towards lower-left.
row3 LEFT SIDE (W): exact left-facing profile, strikes extend towards left.
row4 BACK-LEFT THREE-QUARTER (NW): rear shoulder and back dominate, looking/attacking away towards upper-left, only a slim cheek if physically visible.
row5 BACK (N): full back view, strikes away from camera, absolutely no eyes, smile or frontal face on the back of the head.
CRITICAL: all five rows must have visibly different camera views; do not repeat front faces on rear rows. Keep character body and sprout identity consistent. Whole body poses, not floating limbs or icons.
No text, labels, watermarks, grid, scenery, floor, shadows, weapons, motion swooshes, spark effects or extra accessories. True alpha transparency, not painted checkerboard.
